d:
The Lallantop’s Abhishek Tripathi and Vijay Kumar met a girl in Jharkhand. This girl named Anjali is studying in 6th class and wants to be a CA. Her story along with her sister’s struggle is a message to the whole society. Here is the story of Anjali and her elder sister.
Is vidiyo ka kopirait svamitv indiya tude grup ke pas hai. indiya tude grup ki anumti ke bina, kisi tisre paksh ko vidiyo ka upyog karne ki aagya nahin hai. upyog ki anumti is eemel aaeedi ke madhyam se prapt ki ja sakti hai.
Produced By: The Lallantop
